title: PixelControl
description: Advanced Paper moderation plugin with punishments, AutoMod, Discord synchronization, staff tools, reports, notes, history tracking, logging, and powerful server management systems. 🚀
body:
# PixelControl

PixelControl is a powerful all-in-one moderation and staff management plugin built for Paper servers running Minecraft 1.20.1 through the latest version. Designed for communities of all sizes, PixelControl combines advanced moderation tools, intelligent AutoMod systems, staff management, detailed punishment tracking, and seamless Discord integration into a single professional solution.

The plugin provides a complete punishment system including bans, mutes, warnings, kicks, unbans, and unmutes. Every action is tracked using unique punishment IDs, logged to Discord, and stored in a UUID-based SQLite database for fast and reliable access. Staff can quickly review player histories, moderation records, reports, AutoMod violations, and staff notes through user-friendly interfaces.

PixelControl features an advanced AutoMod engine capable of detecting profanity, advertising, spam, flooding, caps abuse, toxicity, and bypass attempts using symbols, spaces, or special characters. All violations are automatically recorded and can trigger configurable punishments based on escalation rules.

Staff members have access to powerful utilities including Staff Chat, Staff AFK, Staff List, SOS Alerts, Reports, Notes, Staff Statistics, Punishment History, and Staff Dashboards. Every action is synchronized between Minecraft and Discord in real time, allowing staff to moderate the server even when they are not online in-game.

The built-in Discord bot requires no separate hosting and automatically starts with the Minecraft server. It supports slash commands, embeds, buttons, menus, punishment management, history viewing, report handling, staff communication, and live synchronization.

Whether you manage a small SMP or a large Minecraft network, PixelControl delivers a complete moderation ecosystem focused on performance, security, automation, and ease of use.

✔ Ban, Mute, Warn, Kick, Unban & Unmute

✔ Reports System

✔ Discord Synchronization
✔ Discord Slash Commands

✔ SQLite Database Storage

✔ Production Ready

## Minecraft Commands

### Moderation

* /punish <player>
* /warn <player> <reason>
* /warnings <player>
* /kick <player> <reason>
* /unban <player>
* /unmute <player>
* /history <player>
* /hist <player>
* /clearhistory <player>
* /chist <player>

### Staff Utilities

* /staffchat
* /sc
* /safk
* /staffafk
* /stafflist
* /slist
* /sos <message>
* /staffstats
* /staffpanel

### Notes & Reports

* /note <player> <message>
* /notes <player>
* /report <player> <reason>
* /reports

## LuckPerms Permissions

### Helper

pixelcontrol.helper

### Junior Moderator

pixelcontrol.jrmod

### Moderator

pixelcontrol.mod

### Senior Moderator

pixelcontrol.srmod

### Administrator

pixelcontrol.admin

### Senior Administrator

pixelcontrol.sradmin

### Manager

pixelcontrol.manager

### Owner

pixelcontrol.owner

PixelControl automatically detects the highest permission node and assigns the corresponding rank. Permissions are fully compatible with LuckPerms and other permission management plugins.
